s: This article explores Nix Flakes as a solution for creating reproducible, cross-platform development environments, particularly for Python projects with CUDA support, addressing limitations of traditional Python Nix environments by leveraging virtual environments and pip.
sub: Cross-platform Python Nix Flake with CUDA
Solving Python Nix environment issues with venv/pip
Nix Flakes for reproducible system configuration
Comparison of Nix with VMs and Containers
Nix as a language, package manager, and OS
